title: Living the dream — перемены в жизни

items.example: Only a few people actually follow their dreams.
She tells how she made her dream come true.
Perhaps it is time to look for something new.
Many people want to give up their jobs and start a new career.
He decided to give up his job and start a new career.
They would like to travel around the world one day.

items.idiom: go back to work as normal
items.example: When the holiday finishes, they just go back to work as normal.
